title: Grotto Climbing & Yoga

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Give your kids an unforgettable summer at Grotto Climbing & Yoga! Our summer camp is a great opportunity for children new to climbing to begin learning the skills necessary to climb safely, the technique used to climb efficiently, and to gain confidence in themselves in a social and collaborative environment! Climbing isn't only a physical sport. It's a full-body, full-brain challenge that builds resilience, spatial reasoning, and genuine confidence. Here's what your child gains at Grotto's summer climbing camp in San Diego. Campers work on their footwork, body awareness, route-reading skills, and proper technique for bouldering! Every climbing route is a puzzle. Kids learn to read

services.name: Climbing Goals
services.desc: Learn the basics of bouldering to get started safely! We will teach you how to read the difficulty of routes, bouldering techniques, techniques for falling safely, gym rules, and etiquette. Are you thinking about one-on-one personal training, but don’t want to work out in a stuffy gym? Grotto’s Personal Trainers will help you stay accountable, set customized fitness goals, and provide feedback to optimize workouts. Have you been looking to take your climbing to the next level? This Adult League is designed for adults looking to approach climbing more seriously and improve their skills on the wall. Coaches provide a productive environment for adults to pursue their climbing goals regardless
